review: Three independent read-only reviews: padded weight stride/address bound, output/activation/grid tests, and PR scope. No remaining dense-MMQ blockers. Buffer sizes, aliasing, allocation and documented tail-zero ownership remain with callers.
pr_body:
## Problem and implementation

Follow-up to merged #127. The dense MMQ bridge narrowed strides to `int` without proving that padded weight reads, strided output, FP32 partials and activation tile reads fit the kernel's integer offsets. A valid stream-K work count also did not guarantee valid CUDA grid dimensions.

Validate these spans before narrowing, reject overlapping output columns, and check main/fixup/quantizer grids against the current device's `maxGridSize`. Activation sizing rejects unsupported grids before allocation; K padding and quantizer ceil division use safe arithmetic. Activation-size queries now depend on the current CUDA device. Shared activation checks also apply to MoE preparation; its output kernel is unchanged.

Callers still own allocation sizes, aliasing and documented tail zeros. No numerical device kernel, quantization, KV setting or GPU workspace was changed.

## Verification

- 57 CPU work/span/grid/padding boundary cases: PASS under GCC 13.3, `-Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all`. Includes exact `INT_MAX` last indices, `INT64_MAX` stride, strict `2^30` work bound, all grid axes at/above synthetic limits and padding overflow.
- RTX 3090/sm86, CUDA 13.1.115, driver 616.92, Ubuntu 24.04 Docker/WSL2: all 17 types pass exact BF16 Store/Accumulate parity, strided guards/tails/gather and the real Q6_K N5120/K17408/T16 shape. FP32/BF16 invalid-stride calls reject null operands before launch. Actual quantizer-Y limit passes sizing; the next block rejects without allocating a large buffer. Independent FP64 GGUF Op oracle: PASS.
- 19 CUDA units (17 MMQ types, bridge and store test) compile with CUDA 12.9.86 for sm70/75/80/86/89 and CUDA 13.1.115 for sm120a. Other GPUs are compile-only; Windows/full-server execution was not tested.

Validation used #127's code (`26003d67`, tree identical to merged `0020fc44`). The final patch is byte-identical on current master `56aa5f5b`; Ops/Core/vendor/build and focused test dependencies are unchanged. Its new ProductTests entry only registers an unrelated serve test. The focused runner links registered Linear test/bench OBJECT targets and Ops, excluding unrelated attention sources; full application/test bundles were not built.

Runner: 176,620,288 → 176,727,088 bytes (+106,800). GPU workspace is unchanged. No performance claim: earlier #127 timings were not repeated for host validation. Benchmark records remain outside this diff.

Reproduce with the ordinary test bundle:

```sh
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86 -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DNINFER_BUILD_APPS=OFF
cmake --build build -j --target ninfer_tests
build/tests/ninfer_tests ninfer_linear_gguf_mmq_limits_test
build/tests/ninfer_tests ninfer_linear_gguf_mmq_store_test
build/tests/ninfer_tests ninfer_linear_gguf_test
```
timing: Earlier paired measurements belong to 1e041229; validation-only followups were not retimed.
